newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar fails at highs, ends barely moved.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar fails at highs, ends barely moved.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed barely up after the most-active March contract struggled and then failed to reach resistance seen at 10.80, dealers said.
Trade buying carried the contract to a high of 10.78 where it stalled in early dealings. Producer selling pressured the contract towards unchanged by the close.
Overall, activity remained dull, with volume estimated at only 9,706 lots. Wednesday's official volume was 6,348 lots.
March closed up 0.01 at 10.66, having ranged from 10.78 to 10.61. The back months finished unchanged to 0.01 higher.
